title: No-keyword negative control: ASK-fallthrough must not yield 0.85-confidence ASK
review: draft: converted from the V1 litmus corpus; V1 expected PASS or ACK or SPEAK. V1 rationale: Negative control. A future classifier that produces ASK at 0.85 here cannot be trusted to surface real clarifying needs.
